title: Battle of Mingolsheim
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mingolsheim", at revision 1370269473, opens: "The Battle of Mingolsheim was fought on 27 April 1622, near the German village of Wiesloch, 23 km (14 mi) south of Heidelberg, between a Protestant army under General von Mansfeld, Hans Michael Elias von Obentraut, and the Margrave of Baden-Durlach against a Roman Catholic army under Count Tilly." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q835585, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1622 battle in the thirty years war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
